title: Home practical guide and safety card: mirror and torch
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y6 lesson 2 (Home practical guide and safety card: mirror and torch (portal worksheet; plastic mirror, never shine into eyes))
intro: Lesson 2: Reflection: how mirrors bounce light. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To see how a mirror reflects light
equipment: Card with a thin slit (tape over the torch)
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Stand the mirror upright on paper and draw a line along it
Draw the normal at 90° to the mirror
Shine a thin beam at the mirror where the normal meets it; never into eyes
Mark the beam going in and coming out
Measure both angles from the normal

questions.q: Angle of reflection equals angle of...
Big question: how could you send a beam round a corner?
questions.a: Angle a mirror so the light reflects in the new direction (45° turns it through a right angle).
